title: How much and how fast: dose and duration
intro: The water application speed is a parameter in mm/h (default 2 mm/h) and the irrigation lasts a number of hours. The pairs below keep the speed of the manual (2 mm/h) while the dose grows, so the answer is the effect of the dose and not of the speed.
